violated_contract: A target adapter must preserve the canonical request-validation HTTP status and structured field errors; an input ValidationError must not be flattened into a generic domain 400 response.
canonical_prevention: Use one response owner for Pydantic request errors and compare actual ASGI responses against the current upstream FastAPI request models. On 2026-09-04 the shared dual-target HTTP suite found an invalid POST /v1/action-items request returned 400 on Cloudflare and 422 on Server; six real ASGI regression cases fail before this repair.
